fusions.name: Crescent Broadhead
fusions.desc: Looses a crescent-headed arrow that deals 30 damage, rising to twice that at its full reach of 9 tiles, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Fanned Crescents
fusions.desc: Looses 3 small crescents at once in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 3 damage. 15% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Held at Full Draw
fusions.desc: After a 1-second draw, your damage rises by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Follow-Through
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a loosed crescent strikes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 6 damage, then passes on to 2 more within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Once every 5 seconds.
